cm.c: More long-form videos please, they're very informative.

It’s important to note that the colonies begged king George for representation in parliament in order to avoid a war and the king still said no. The colonies wanted to become part of the United Kingdo
Finally.. it's always an amazing video. Waiting for more of them
I appreciate your animations and always anticipate the release of your new videos. This deserves more attention. Keep posting.
if you’re wondering why you don’t see Vermont in those 13 colonies, it’s because it was its own independent Republic
This is like oversimplified but honestly I like your style a little more. Still kind of jokey but not overly so, concentrated on the history more than anything. Make more long form videos plz!
US history lesson in 2 min and 49 sec
